g.text: Freeze and drand: nobody can choose inputs after seeing the randomness
Round N is fixed before any application exists, and the inputs are hashed before round N's value exists.

Missed the deadline? The program stays locked. Picking a new round would let
the operator choose after seeing output, so it is never automated.
Judge sandbox timing: round due 45 s after the close, freeze at least 15 s before
it. Production: close + 3 h and N − 30 min. Demo time only moves the sandbox's own
